likely_error.vi: Gọi output/search/transform trước producer hoặc dùng state version cũ.
likely_error.en: Calling output/search/transform before its producer or using a stale state version.

consequence.vi: Call nhận state rỗng/cũ và workflow cho kết quả sai dù không lỗi cú pháp.
consequence.en: A call consumes empty/stale state and the workflow is wrong without a syntax failure.

detection_check.vi: Gắn version number vào state sau mỗi mutation và kiểm mọi call đọc latest producer.
detection_check.en: Attach a version number after every state mutation and verify every call reads the latest producer.

repair_action.vi: Sắp lại topological order theo dependency edges; truyền trực tiếp latest result/state.
repair_action.en: Restore topological order from dependency edges and pass the latest result/state directly.

error_rows.authority_note: AlgoCore risk derived from the method invariant; no examiner-frequency or fixed-mark-loss claim.

likely_error.vi: Không lưu return, trộn result giữa iterations hoặc lặp sai số lần.
likely_error.en: Failing to store a return, mixing results between iterations or repeating the wrong number of times.

consequence.vi: Branch/output không gắn với input đã tạo result hoặc thiếu/thừa call.
consequence.en: A branch/output no longer belongs to the input that produced the result, or calls are missing/extra.

detection_check.vi: Lập bảng iteration→input→call→return→branch và so row count với contract.
detection_check.en: Build an iteration→input→call→return→branch table and compare row count with the contract.

repair_action.vi: Giữ result local cho mỗi iteration, commit branch trước khi tăng counter và khóa exact repeat bound.
repair_action.en: Keep the result local to each iteration, commit its branch before incrementing the counter and lock the exact repeat bound.

error_rows.authority_note: AlgoCore risk derived from the method invariant; no examiner-frequency or fixed-mark-loss claim.

likely_error.vi: Có đúng values nhưng thiếu label/separator/newline hoặc ghép sai field order.
likely_error.en: Having correct values but missing a label/separator/newline or concatenating fields in the wrong order.

consequence.vi: Observable text/return không khớp contract dù computation đúng.
consequence.en: The observable text/return violates the contract even though computation is correct.

detection_check.vi: Tách expected line thành token literal/field/separator và đối chiếu từng token cùng line break.
detection_check.en: Tokenise the expected line into literal/field/separator tokens and compare every token plus line break.

repair_action.vi: Dựng fragment từ grammar cố định rồi thay field đúng vị trí; không tự paraphrase literal nguồn.
repair_action.en: Build the fragment from a fixed grammar and substitute fields in place; do not paraphrase source literals.

error_rows.authority_note: AlgoCore risk derived from the method invariant; no examiner-frequency or fixed-mark-loss claim.

likely_error.vi: In logical items khi đề cần physical slots, hoặc bỏ unused slot/đảo row-column.
likely_error.en: Printing logical items when physical slots are required, or omitting unused slots/swapping row-column order.

consequence.vi: Output thiếu/thừa/reordered item và không còn đại diện representation nguồn.
consequence.en: Output has missing/extra/reordered items and no longer represents the source representation.

detection_check.vi: Dùng item có index/value phân biệt, ghi visited-index sequence và so exact start/end/count.
detection_check.en: Use distinct index/value items, record the visited-index sequence and compare exact start/end/count.

repair_action.vi: Khóa iterator/range bằng QP trước render; tách physical listing khỏi traversal/sorted sequence.
repair_action.en: Lock iterator/range from the QP before rendering; separate physical listing from traversal/sorted sequence.

error_rows.authority_note: AlgoCore risk derived from the method invariant; no examiner-frequency or fixed-mark-loss claim.

likely_error.vi: Plan chỉ chụp output, thiếu prescribed input, case id, file contents hoặc filename bắt buộc.
likely_error.en: Planning an output-only capture that omits prescribed input, case id, file contents or a required filename.

consequence.vi: Ảnh tương lai không chứng minh observable thuộc đúng test case.
consequence.en: The future image cannot establish that the observable belongs to the prescribed case.

detection_check.vi: Đối chiếu capture contents với mọi cột input/output/file/filename của evidence matrix.
detection_check.en: Compare capture contents with every input/output/file/filename column in the evidence matrix.

repair_action.vi: Mở rộng frame/capture set để hiển thị đủ attribution; đặt slot name chứa case id.
repair_action.en: Expand the frame/capture set to show full attribution and include the case id in the slot name.

error_rows.authority_note: AlgoCore risk derived from the method invariant; no examiner-frequency or fixed-mark-loss claim.

likely_error.vi: Viết rằng test đã chạy/pass hoặc gán expected output thành observed evidence ở Stage 4.
likely_error.en: Stating that a test ran/passed or treating expected output as observed evidence in Stage 4.

consequence.vi: Authority boundary bị phá và reviewer không phân biệt plan với bằng chứng thật.
consequence.en: The authority boundary breaks and reviewers cannot distinguish a plan from real evidence.

detection_check.vi: Quét mọi status/narrative để tìm past-tense execution claims và kiểm không có screenshot/runtime artifact được dẫn.
detection_check.en: Scan every status/narrative for past-tense execution claims and confirm no screenshot/runtime artifact is cited.

repair_action.vi: Đổi sang planned/expected/PENDING_STAGE5_6 và giao capture verification cho Stage 5/6.
repair_action.en: Change wording to planned/expected/PENDING_STAGE5_6 and hand capture verification to Stage 5/6.

error_rows.authority_note: AlgoCore risk derived from the method invariant; no examiner-frequency or fixed-mark-loss claim.
